# VeilPix - AI Image and Video Generator

## Overview
VeilPix is a free-to-try, privacy-focused AI image and video generator for photo editing, text-to-image creation, text-to-video generation, image-to-video animation, and reference-to-video workflows.

## Key Facts
- Free tier: 30 credits after sign-up
- AI image models: Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5 Lite/Pro, Wan 2.7 Image
- AI video models: Seedance 2.5 for up to 30-second text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, and multimodal reference generation; Wan 2.6 text-to-video; Wan 2.6 Flash image-to-video; and Wan 2.7 reference-to-video
- Privacy: Browser-local creative history, no public creation feed, and AI requests proxied through VeilPix; provider retention applies
- Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC (auto-converted), common video references such as MP4, WebM, and MOV, and Seedance 2.5 output in MP4 or MOV

## Features
1. AI Photo Editing - Retouch images, remove objects, change colors, and adjust lighting
2. Text-to-Image - Generate new images from natural-language prompts
3. Multi-image Composition - Combine reference images into new outputs
4. Text-to-Video - Create Wan 2.6 or Seedance 2.5 videos from written prompts
5. Image-to-Video - Animate still images with Wan 2.6 Flash or Seedance 2.5
6. Reference-to-Video - Guide Wan 2.7 or Seedance 2.5 videos with image and video references
7. Seedance 2.5 - Generate clips up to 30 seconds using text, image, video, and audio inputs with MP4 or MOV output
8. Long-Form Video Continuation - Continue from a provider-returned or locally extracted last frame, save that frame to the local gallery, and stitch clips in the Video Editor
9. Privacy-Focused Workflow - Creation history stays in the browser instead of a persistent VeilPix server-side library

## Age-Verified After Dark
VeilPix includes an age-verified 18+ mode for private NSFW and adult creative workflows where supported by the selected model provider. VeilPix still applies account controls, provider safety systems, and misuse prevention.

## AI Models
- Nano Banana 2: Gemini-powered image editing and generation
- Seedream 5 Lite/Pro: ByteDance models for economical high-resolution generation or higher-precision creative work
- Wan 2.7 Image: Image generation and editing for prompt and reference workflows
- Wan 2.6: Text-to-video generation
- Wan 2.6 Flash: Image-to-video generation
- Wan 2.7: Reference-to-video generation
- Seedance 2.5: Up to 30-second multimodal video generation with text, image, video, and audio inputs, MP4 or MOV output, and last-frame continuation

## Pricing
- Free to try: 30 credits after sign-up
- Additional credits: Available in one-time packages at the current prices shown in VeilPix
- No subscription required

## Use Cases
- Photo retouching and enhancement
- Object removal and addition
- Artistic filters and style transfer
- Color correction and lighting adjustment
- Image composition and blending
- Text-to-video clips for social, concept, and creative production
- Image-to-video animation from still images
- Reference-to-video generation using image and video inputs
